name: Daphne Tse
reason: Too thin as a teacher: her only Esalen programme is as guest musician in Cristi Christensen's Seven Flames retreat (already in that plan), her YouTube channel and shop are music-only (mantra songs, albums), the Samahita retreats on her calendar list the Samahita team rather than her, her Resonance Rising retreat (May 2026) has passed, and the one future co-taught programme (Samahita Breath Summit, Aug 2027) is titled 'Practice, Rest & Heal' (borderline health wording), leaving fewer than three usable items.
